blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِيْ يُخَالِطُ النَّاسَ وَيَصْبِرُ عَلَي اَذَاهُمْ، اَعْظَمُ اَجْرًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّّذِيْ لَايُخَالِطُ النَّاسَ وَلَايَصْبِرُ عَلَي اَذَاهُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب الصبر علي البلاء رقم:٤٠٣٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The believer who mixes with people and bears patiently the hardships caused by them is better than the Mu'min (believer) who does not mix with people and does not bear the difficulties caused by them.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: عَجَبًا لِاَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ اِنَّ اَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ لَهُ خَيْرٌ، وَلَيْسَ ذلِكَ لِاَحَدٍ اِلَّا لِلْمُؤْمِنِ، اِنْ اَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ، وَاِنْ اَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب المؤمن امره كله خير رقم:٧٥٠٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Suhaib (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The affairs of a Mu'min are truly amazing! Every one of his affairs, in every state, brings him only great good. This blessing is granted only to the Mu'min: if something joyful happens to him, he gives thanks to his Lord. This giving of thanks becomes a cause of good for him (there is reward for him in it); if hardship comes to him, he adopts patience. His being patient is also a cause of good for him (there is reward for him in his patience too).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُوْدٍ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُوْلُ: اَللّهُمَّ
